NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author rebased onto main (one push, same +24/-4 in one file), and CI passes. They said the PR addresses #37647, but nothing else changed.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️  | The feedback asked for discussion first. Issue #37647 exists, but the PR doesn't link it with "Fixes: #37647", and the input doesn't show whether it has "help wanted". |
| ❌  | The PR template is incomplete. There is no "Fixes: #N", no description of how it was tested, no before/after screenshots for this UI change, and no self-review checklist. |
| ⚠️  | Open PR #39267 ("channel folder: Improve selector spacing and row alignment") covers the same issue. Two earlier PRs (#38352, #38370) for it were closed. |
| ℹ️  | CI passing is not a concern here. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready". Check whether #37647 has "help wanted" and how #39267 relates. If the issue isn't "help wanted" or #39267 is the active attempt, closing is an option, since the author has no merged PRs.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the rebase, @Shinu-Cherian! Please link the issue with "Fixes: #37647" and complete the PR template, including how you tested and before/after screenshots of the dropdowns. Also take a look at #39267, which targets the same issue, and tell us how this PR differs.
```
